candidates.title: [Feature]: Support LiquidAI LFM3 models
candidates.snippet: ### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch  LiquidAI released LFM3 on 2026-10-27: LFM3-1.7B (text), LFM3-VL-2B, LFM3-Audio-2B, LFM3-Omni-2B and the d1 models. vLLM has no `Lfm3ForCausalLM`.  LFM3 is close to LFM2, which vLLM already serves. The differences:  - Three layer types instead of two: gated short conv, full attention and sliding attention (`sliding_window: 256`). - The short conv has width 7 (`conv_L_cache: 7`). candidates.title: SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_FAST_WARMUP on DeepSeek-V4.1: 3-5x faster cold start, no runtime degradation detectable at chunked-prefill 16384
candidates.snippet: ## Background  `SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_FAST_WARMUP` (default `False`) is documented as:  > Precompile less kernels during warmup, which reduces the warmup time from 30min to less than 3min. Might cause performance degradation during runtime.  The first half is measured everywhere. The second half has no published numbers, so in practice people who need fast cold starts are reluctant to turn it on for a serving deployment.
